title: UFOs over nuclear bases every night of Travis Walton's disappearance
place_text: Loring, Wurtsmith, Minot, Malmstrom AFBs, United States

tellings.quote: And one of the stories people don't know that Travis was taken on November the 5th to the 10th. Every night that Travis was gone, there was a UFO over a nuclear missile or a nuclear weapon storage area in the United States.

plain: Every night that Travis Walton, a man who said he was taken by a UFO, was missing, from November 5 to 10, 1975, a UFO is said to have appeared over a nuclear missile site or nuclear weapons storage area in the United States, at Air Force bases such as Loring, Wurtsmith, Minot and Malmstrom. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells this as a little-known part of the case, without naming his source, and offers it as a sign that the two things were linked.
